name: manual_005241
claim: Do not assume a branch tip is merged just because its PR shows MERGED — GitHub merges the PR snapshot at merge time; agents that push after merge create a divergent branch tip that main never receives.

decisions.notes: Classic multi-agent race: agent A merges, agent B pushes memory/CI fixes to same branch minutes later.

rationale: Classic multi-agent race: agent A merges, agent B pushes memory/CI fixes to same branch minutes later.
